# Games Bundle Skill

Curated by Skill Harbor. This is not a fixed pack that installs many game skills at once, and it is not a page that only links to other pages. It is a dynamic orchestrator: a single skill that works for you, in plain words, at the moment you want to play or organize a game.

How it works, in order: 1. You say what you want to play, in normal words, or what kind of game night you want. No jargon needed. 2. It does a quick check of what fits here: number of players, time available, solo or group, quiet or lively, quiz or board style game. 3. It searches Skill Harbor for skills that fit that need. 4. By default, it only looks for free skills that need no API key, no account, and no payment. That way it works right away, with no setup. 5. It reads the full description of each candidate, compares it to your need, and shows you a short list, three to five skills, with what each one does, what it does not do, one fit and one limit for your case, and its verification status. It never invents a skill, never declares a single best skill, and never hides a requirement. If a popularity signal is shown, such as GitHub stars, it is labelled popularity only, never quality. 6. It waits for your go before installing anything. Nothing is installed without the list shown first. 7. It installs only what you approved, helps step by step, and then explains the game simply, with clear rules and next steps.

If you want to go deeper, say so. Only then, on your explicit word, it can look at API...
